component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "drain" m.applied = 0 m.inTask = false end sub
' One bad update: its observer throws, which the task's try/catch around wait() absorbs. sub onReq(event as object) if not m.inTask then return m.applied++ if event.getData() = 5 then throw "boom on 5" end sub
sub drain() m.inTask = true m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("request", m.port) m.top.ready = true events = 0 caught = 0 for attempt = 0 to 40 try msg = wait(100, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" then events++ catch e caught++ end try end for m.top.report = "onChange ran=" + m.applied.toStr() + " port events=" + events.toStr() + " caught=" + caught.toStr() + " final field=" + m.top.request.toStr() end sub
